bio.text: Jason Buchsbaum, a Republican, has represented District 69 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since January 8, 2025, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.
He earned a bachelor's degree from George Washington University and a law degree from the University of Connecticut in 2005, and his career includes serving as a partner at Cohen and Wolf, P.C.
He previously served on the Southbury Board of Selectmen and, from 2007 to 2009, on the Seymour Board of Education.
